title: Three exact results on dynamical spin-chain supersymmetry
description: Proofs of the exact signed trigonometric singlet counts for every spin and admissible twist, the odd-parity Fateev–Zamolodchikov states of Hagendorf Conjecture 4.8 in their specified momentum, and full ground kernels and gap bounds for the deformed t–J chain. AI-assisted and internally checked.
